cases.invariant: Actual initialize, tools/list and resources/read succeed; skill version is retrievable; supported tool names match callable schemas.
No MCP tool can publish, send, schedule host work, or enable the standalone worker.
Missing, malformed, expired and revoked credentials disclose no private tool/resource data.
One authorized identity cannot select, infer or mutate another identity's workspace through tool args, resources, receipts or errors.
Malformed inputs fail explicitly without writes or provider requests.
Stale expectedRevision cannot overwrite a newer confirmed profile.
Identical retried writes produce one persisted mutation; reusing a key with a changed payload fails explicitly.
Profile, scope, feedback, voice history and host-plan references survive process/database reopen.
A channel-only voice correction affects no other channel and does not rewrite host private identity.
Restoring a previous voice produces an auditable revision and restores exactly the selected scoped values.
Growth recommendation lacks confirmed task status until a host receipt exists; cancellation is reconciled without rescheduling.
Host-reported publication remains reported; queued state never becomes published; self-supplied verified flags cannot create independently verified outcome.
Internal-only sources are excluded from public context before tool results are constructed.
An unavailable Evidence8 service reports its failure without invented visuals, pixels, source claims or readiness.
Visual candidates retain publisher/source/date and unknown interpretation or rights; metadata completeness never implies inspection.
Outcome observations retain age, scope, source and evidence type; unverified host observations never silently become confirmed world evidence.
Conflicting observations remain inspectable; empirical strategy changes do not rewrite identity/Taste.
Only inputs.json can enter generation cognition; private grading and deterministic assertions cannot become MCP resources or tool context.
